_: spec 441 — THE ESTATE'S DECLARATION. Five inputs, the agents the build charters, and this estate's own extras. Everything else about the deployment is DERIVED from these (scripts/estate-shape.mts) or is the town's baseline, and `pnpm check:estate-shape` fails when the deployment disagrees. Edit this file, never a derived var in wrangler.toml.
_callerSubjects: The two KMS caller subjects this estate holds. Re-bound 2026-10-14 through `bind-caller --profile estate-vault|estate-runtime`, so these are the shape every estate gets rather than a hand-derived set — 8 operations and 6, down from 11 each. The superseded `demo-mcp-faithnet-vault-5` / `demo-a2a-faithnet-runtime-6` are disabled on the CVM.
_residents: The DEMO personas whose custodian keys this Home holds, so the builder can re-issue their DEL-001 session leaves server-side after the interactions key changes (441 §7.2 step 3). A real resident re-issues by clicking through their own Home; this list is never a roster of who lives here.
_agents: OUTPUTS of the build, not inputs: this estate chartered its own. An estate that reuses another estate's interactions SA is not a second estate (439 §7.13).
_extras: PRODUCT and TOWN settings. Real, kept, and deliberately NOT part of being an estate — the 101st estate needs none of them to be an estate (spec 441 D1). Declared here so they stop reading as estate shape.
